name: Tirunelveli
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 settlement point; not shifted and not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Tirunelveli District Administration land-record page identifies the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records at the Collector office in Kokkirakulam, Tirunelveli, and links the official Tamil Nadu land-record e-Services. This is local custodian/service evidence only, not evidence of anonymous parcel geometry or ownership.
technicalBlocker: The official public routes reviewed either expose service descriptions/login-gated land-management functionality or did not return a usable public map/API response. No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus complete polygon was verified. No login, credential, token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe field request was used.
